findings.title: Description issues instructions to the model
findings.detail: Description of "get_sales_market" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

evidence.snippet: The count of sales roles open today and of those posted over the past 7 days, split by kind of sales work and by hiring company (each with the slug search_sales…

findings.remediation: Treat the server as untrusted; the model may obey embedded instructions.

findings.title: Toxic flow: untrusted input can reach an external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: get_sales_pay · Public sink: get_sales_pay.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: get_sales_pay · Public sink: get_sales_pay

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "search_sales_jobs" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
